races.paceDynamic: Goodie Girl is the lone confirmed front runner and will dictate proceedings from the flag, likely getting an uncontested lead through the early stages. With most runners adopting hold-up tactics (Typical Thomas, Black Soul, Garnetot, King Of The Greys, Liceo, Cozone, Emesteraye, Rogue Sea), the pace will be measured rather than fierce. The prominent runners Arcland, Cooladdi and Warm In Gorey will track behind Goodie Girl but won't apply serious early pressure. This setup strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions without expending energy, while the large contingent of hold-up horses will face a significant disadvantage trying to make up ground from the back of the field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Goodie Girl Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If Goodie Girl gets an easy lead and dictates the fractions uncontested
scenarios.body: She can kick clear turning for home before the hold-up brigade gets organised, making full use of her class and tactical advantage. The measured early pace leaves her with plenty in reserve for a sustained finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Pays
scenarios.trigger: If Arcland or Warm In Gorey apply genuine pressure to Goodie Girl from halfway
scenarios.body: The increased tempo will stretch the field and expose Goodie Girl's long absence, allowing the prominent trackers to strike in the final furlong. Hold-up horses still struggle with too much ground to make up.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace completely collapses and becomes crawling
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where stamina matters less and the sheer volume of hold-up horses creates a cavalry charge. Fresh horses like Typical Thomas and Cozone can exploit their recent runs.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent horses decide to take on Goodie Girl early
scenarios.body: A genuine speed duel develops that sets up perfectly for closers, but requires multiple pace angles to materialise simultaneously. Unlikely given the field composition but would transform the race completely.

watchPoints.text: Goodie Girl must handle the ground after 196-day absence, any early struggling kills the front-running plan
Watch for Arcland to track Goodie Girl closely early - he has the class to apply pressure when it matters
Black Soul and King Of The Greys both fade in finishes, avoid if they're prominent late in betting
Warm In Gorey's consistency suggests he'll run his race but needs others to set it up from prominent position
Monitor early pace through first half-mile - if genuinely slow it opens door for hold-up horses like Typical Thomas

races.paceDynamic: Western Model will take this race on from the front with only Forever And A Day, Mount Shenshan and Hitthehayson likely to race handy in the early stages. This creates an uncontested lead scenario where Western Model can dictate fractions over the 2m6f trip without serious early pressure. The bulk of this large field - including all the higher-rated horses Nakassama and San Franco - are hold-up performers who will need the pace to develop. This race shape strongly favours the prominent racers and early pace-setters who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will unfold in the closing stages with so many hold-up horses fighting for room.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Western Model gets an easy lead and dictates moderate fractions
scenarios.body: Western Model builds an unassailable advantage turning for home as the hold-up brigade get caught in traffic behind. The prominent racers Forever And A Day and Mount Shenshan pick up the pieces while the class horses struggle for a clear run.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold Up Class Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and the field comes together late
scenarios.body: Nakassama and San Franco utilize their superior ratings as gaps appear in the final furlong. Their class tells despite the tactical disadvantage of racing from behind in this large field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Western Model goes too slow early and gets swamped by the field
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge from the final hurdle with multiple horses in contention. Steps In The Sand's return from a long layoff could catch rivals napping if the pace sets up perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the favorite encounters trouble and an outsider gets the perfect trip
scenarios.body: One of the lower-weighted hold-up horses like Andyourbirdcansing or Watty Show benefits from a strong pace and finds gaps when others cannot. Their light weights become decisive in a messy finish.

watchPoints.text: Western Model could steal this if allowed uncontested lead as no other genuine pace horses in field

races.paceDynamic: Lady Fromentro will lead from the start with Nothing Hectic, Joya Del Mar, and Moonshine Girl tracking prominently in the opening stages. This modest pace will allow the large field of hold-up horses to settle and travel comfortably through the early phases. The race will develop into a sprint from the final hurdle as the prominent runners try to kick clear while the hold-up brigade mount their challenges. This controlled tempo and tactical finish strongly favours prominent runners who can position handy and have the class to quicken when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays controlled and the prominent horses maintain their positions turning for home
scenarios.body: The handy runners will have first run on the field and the superior horses among them can exploit their positional advantage. The hold-up horses will have too much ground to make up in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group go too hard from the last hurdle and tie up
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses with proven stamina will benefit from the strong pace and come through to collar the leaders in the final 100 yards. This scenario rewards horses who stay the trip well.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Outsider Springs Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites fail to fire and the race falls apart tactically
scenarios.body: Georgia Celena or Moonshine Girl could exploit their light weights and proven form on similar ground to outrun their odds. The race becomes more open with the established horses underperforming.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Fromentro sets a very slow pace and kicks too late
scenarios.body: The entire field will be bunched turning for home creating a cavalry charge finish where any horse could win. This chaos scenario makes the result almost impossible to predict with certainty.

races.paceDynamic: Leave In Secret will lead from flag-fall with minimal pressure in the early stages, creating a controlled gallop over the opening circuit. The absence of other confirmed front-runners means Leave In Secret can dictate terms without being hassled, likely producing a sustainable pace that builds gradually. With most runners adopting prominent or hold-up tactics, the race will develop into a sprint finish from the home turn as the field bunches up behind the lone leader. This measured tempo strongly favours hold-up horses and late-finishing types who can unleash a decisive kick in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Leave In Secret maintains an uncontested lead setting moderate fractions
scenarios.body: The sustainable gallop allows hold-up horses to conserve energy and time their challenge perfectly, with the pace quickening dramatically only in the final half-mile. Ringdufferin and Truckers Cruising can exploit their preferred racing pattern.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Capitalize
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate pace becomes too slow and front-runners maintain control
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows Leave In Secret and other prominent types to control the race throughout, making it difficult for closers to peg back the advantage. Freddie Robdal and Andys Flame can track the leader and kick clear.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Finnians Row Spring Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the lightweight bottom-weight gets a dream run through on the rail
scenarios.body: McKenna's 3lb claim becomes crucial as Finnians Row travels smoothly in behind before producing a withering late surge that catches the higher-rated horses napping. The 157lbs burden allows sustained acceleration.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Leader Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Leave In Secret's long absence proves no hindrance and maintains strong gallop
scenarios.body: The 181-day layoff hasn't dulled Leave In Secret's speed as he stretches the field from halfway and proves too strong in the closing stages. The lack of early pressure preserves stamina for a powerful finish.

races.paceDynamic: Saunton Surf will lead this from the start with no other confirmed front runners to challenge his position early. The prominent runners Anodandawink, Schiehallion and Tropical Image will settle just behind, but none are likely to pressure the leader through the early stages. With multiple hold-up horses including Coolboy Christy, Coppola, Huntsgrove and Kalsman waiting to pounce, this sets up a tactical affair where the pace could become pedestrian mid-race before accelerating late. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and strong finishers who can benefit from the likely slow early gallop and kick clear when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Saunton Surf sets a steady pace without early pressure from the prominent horses
scenarios.body: The tempo becomes pedestrian allowing the back markers to close easily, then the race explodes late when Coolboy Christy, Coppola and Kalsman unleash finishing kicks. The patient tactics and class of the hold-up brigade proves decisive in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front end collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Saunton Surf goes too fast early or the prominent horses apply more pressure than expected
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes unsustainable causing the leaders to weaken dramatically in the final furlong. This allows the hold-up horses to sweep past a tiring field with minimal resistance.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Wire-to-wire shock
scenarios.trigger: If Saunton Surf is left completely alone in front and the field becomes too tactical behind
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage while the field marks each other up, with none of the hold-up horses able to reel him in despite the slow pace. His recent Downpatrick form suggests he handles the track well.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses position perfectly and avoid the tactical battle behind
scenarios.body: Anodandawink or Schiehallion track the leader closely enough to strike when the pace lifts but avoid getting caught in traffic when the hold-up horses make their moves. Their forward position proves crucial when the race unfolds slowly.

watchPoints.text: Saunton Surf could steal this if given too easy a lead as the only front runner against multiple hold-up horses

Three horses carry 7lb claiming jockeys which adds extra pressure in a tight finish
Kalsman's trainer has poor recent form but this horse has excellent course record and handles conditions

races.paceDynamic: Shantou Show will dictate terms from the front with minimal early pressure, creating a controlled gallop that suits his veteran stamina. The prominent runners Miss Lia, Sampoet, U Asking Me, Toor Moon and Fr Gilligansvoyge will track within striking distance but none are aggressive pace-forcers. With 10 of 13 runners adopting hold-up tactics, the bulk of the field will be bunched behind the moderate early pace. This race shape strongly favours prominent/front-running horses who can secure good positions early and avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will plague the large hold-up contingent in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Shantou Show maintains his uncontested lead and the pace stays moderate throughout
scenarios.body: The veteran can use his stamina advantage over the extended trip while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from poor positions. His prominent style perfectly suits a race where early positioning proves crucial.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Hold-Up Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from the home turn and gaps appear for the back markers
scenarios.body: The class horses The Rebel County and Big Island can use their higher ratings to power through late. Their stamina will tell over this demanding distance if they find racing room.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Division Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the front runners fade and the prominent trackers inherit the lead entering the straight
scenarios.body: Horses like Sampoet and U Asking Me can capitalize on ideal stalking positions behind a moderate pace. They avoid both the early exertion and the traffic problems plaguing others.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Upset
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish from the final fence
scenarios.body: A lightly-weighted outsider like Fr Gilligansvoyge or Toor Moon can benefit from their reduced burden in a tactical affair. The compressed finish negates class differentials.
